purpose: Challenge the selected point-in-time operating-leverage mechanism against the complete current 81-definition catalog and the eight older quality semantic definitions before any Campaign058 source row or value is read.

selected_mechanism.name: quarterly_profit_revenue_growth_spread_pp
selected_mechanism.economic_hypothesis: A positive point-in-time gap between profit growth and revenue growth represents operating leverage or margin expansion that may persist over the next-open-to-third-close horizon.
selected_mechanism.formula: profit_yoy_state_t - revenue_yoy_state_t in percentage points after strict-next-session availability, same-effective-date deduplication, and independent per-field forward fill.

overlap_challenges.reason: The two older definitions rank each growth level separately. Campaign058 is unchanged when the two levels move by the same percentage-point amount and changes sign when their ordering reverses; neither level alone determines the spread.

Quality growth averages revenue/profit percentile ranks and quality score additionally averages ROE. They reward jointly large levels. Campaign058 subtracts raw same-unit states, reads no ROE, and distinguishes operating leverage from common growth. No terminal percentile value is loaded or combined.

Those definitions compare the current fiscal quarter with the same fiscal quarter one year earlier and require an acceleration history. Campaign058 uses only the latest already-effective revenue/profit growth states and contains no prior-year-quarter difference or ROE.

The three terminal disclosure factors use report and announcement dates only. Holding availability dates fixed while changing the two growth states changes Campaign058; holding the states fixed while changing disclosure timing leaves its value unchanged once the same state is effective.
Campaign058 reads no minute close or return. It is constant between effective accounting-state changes and cannot reproduce any same-day or cross-day price-path statistic.
Campaign058 reads no minute open, high, low, range, body, wick, gap, frontier, or extreme field.
Campaign058 reads no minute volume, amount, transaction price, or VWAP and has no activity weighting or clock distribution.
No market, industry, peer, leave-one-out benchmark, beta, correlation, or dispersion state enters Campaign058.

Candidate49 is a future-only causal close-versus-cumulative-VWAP crossing count. Campaign058 is historical-only accounting-state research, loads no Candidate49 value, and performs no signal or execution backfill.
The score is computed directly from two same-unit source fields. It does not load a terminal factor value, percentile score, fitted weight, regime, threshold, subset, or model.

design_choices_frozen_before_values.availability: first accepted session strictly after announcement_date

decision.next_action: Freeze one exact coverage-first 89-comparison no-return protocol before implementing or reading any Campaign058 source row or value.
